formal_entry.environment: Formal executable, real OpenAI HTTP/SSE adapter, Client/Engine/SQL/Native/CodingToolBundle/Outbox; external model and gh boundaries are explicit offline protocol fixtures only.

business_assertions: Inferred auto candidate loads real installed GitHub thread context, applies every enabled rule plus settled-direction/intent-evidence gates, commits the Engine decision and mandate, runs actual Worker write/report, replies through Outbox, and does not repeat after restart.

Observe records would_accept and proposal without Worker/workspace/reply. Design decisions and no matched rule produce ignore with the original reason array and direction/rule audit. Explicit candidates refuse eval but remain routable.

Missing/duplicate rules, missing intent evidence, over-100-word Chinese acknowledgement, forged messages/cursors, hidden repository paths and finished evaluation references visibly fail without starting work.

Text reads retain ordinary Chinese/emoji, enforce path/reference scope, cache offset pages and filter hidden directory entries. Loaded thread window includes first five plus five neighbours; only the requested trigger is marked and top-level text is not duplicated.

Batch triggers share one bounded initial context load while context/default-message reads resolve each requested trigger identity, not the first loader. One ignore decision consumes both batch trigger IDs.

Context timeout remains visible as unavailable context; actual gh child is cancelled and joined. SIGINT during an in-flight assessment seed joins the child before lease release and never authorizes/prepares work.

business_dependency.reason: Chinese/English acknowledgement word limits, not global JS/Intl fidelity
